Hi Anna —

Great to meet earlier this week. Thanks for walking through your inference needs and the volume profile; I pulled together a concise estimate and a couple of configuration options that map to the throughput/latency targets you mentioned. The deck attached includes:
- A baseline hosted plan (pay-as-you-go) and a Dedicated capacity option for predictable throughput.
- Expected per-token unit costs across typical sequence lengths.
- Suggested caching + batching knobs we’d apply to keep costs down while hitting latency SLOs.

Attachment: Redwood_Pricing_Estimate_v2.pdf (PDF, 230KB)

If helpful, I can walk through the numbers in 15 minutes — available next week Tue/Thu mornings. If your priority/timing has shifted, no problem to regroup later; just let me know.

Next step I suggest: 15-minute sync to validate assumptions and quick checklist for procurement.

Thanks,
